decision.observation: Sprint carried me up — now standing on the crest with a further low sand rise ahead toward open purple sky; the dark palm-topped cliff with its blue glow is now at left, closer. A small blue segment sits at the right end of the stamina bar while green stays high.
decision.hypothesis: The crest is reached and the next sand rise looks gentle; continuing forward on foot should cross it. Fewer obstacles ahead than behind.
decision.memory: Sprinting (W+Shift) did advance the steep sand where plain W stalled — sprint is the tool for sand gradient. Blue segment can also appear from sprinting, not only gripping.
